summary: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its merger agreement with Pasqal Holding SAS. The amendment assigns the rights and obligations of the original merger sub to a new subsidiary (New Merger Sub) and includes a deed of counter-guarantee to secure Nativist SAS's obligations. No price, premium, or timeline changes were disclosed. The board likely recommends the deal, though no advisor is named. The structural adjustment is procedural, clarifying the merger vehicle. What to watch: shareholder vote timing and redemptions, as typical for SPAC de-SPAC transactions.
